description: This file contains provider-specific adapter functions for LiteLLM, including functions to extract provider names from model strings, apply provider-specific parameter patches (notably for OpenAI), and filter out None values from parameter dictionaries.

methods.name: get_provider_from_model
methods.description: Extracts the provider name from a model string formatted as 'provider/model-name'. Returns 'unknown' if the format does not match.

methods.name: apply_openai_patches
methods.description: Applies OpenAI-specific parameter patches, notably renaming 'max_tokens' to 'max_completion_tokens'.

methods.name: apply_provider_patches
methods.description: Main function to detect provider from model string and apply corresponding patches, currently supports OpenAI.

methods.name: filter_none_values
methods.description: Removes key-value pairs with None values from the parameter dictionary.
